dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you afraid I might break something?

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Of course not. If you break something, you'll have to pay for it, that's all. But if the matter troubles you so...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: I can be one to bring out and show you the objects that take your fancy. And if they break then...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Heh, I suppose it'll come out of my salary.
